newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BEL-20 CLOSES AT NEW HIGH, BOOSTED BY ROYALE BELGE.
newsitem.headline: BEL-20 CLOSES AT NEW HIGH, BOOSTED BY ROYALE BELGE.

text.p: The Bel-20 share index beat its all-time high on Wednesday with the help of firmer performances of its neighbouring stock exchanges and some steady Belgian index performers.

The Bel-20 ended up 5.54 points, or 0.3 percent, at 1,837.17, surpassing its previous all-time high of 1834.30, helped by falls in capital market interest rates and firm rises in blue chips Royale Belge and UCB .
"The lack of bad news, and the rise in Royale Belge and UCB helped the index as a whole," a trader said.
One analyst said the Bel-20 index would have shown a fall if Royale Belge and UCB were excluded, indicating a not so strong overall performance of the index.
Royale Belge ended up 3.1 percent at 6,700 francs on reports that its co-owner, France's UAP , might merge it with AXA Belgium , following its own linkup with AXA France, an analyst said.
Pharmaceutical company UCB ended up 2.3 percent at 72,750 francs.
Steelmaker Cockerill ended down 1.2 percent, reflecting weakness in British steel stocks, one trader said.

"Over the next month we're likely see good gains on the Bel-20 index", a dealer said. He said, however, that in the near term the market was likely to experience "a period of consolidation, with Wall Street not likely to rise much more and interest rates having bottomed out."
One dealer forecast Bel-20 to range between 1800 and 1850 for the rest of this year.
